major_concerns: Verifier false negatives and oracle incompleteness could bias measured improvements.
Public datasets may underrepresent vendor-specific constructs, limiting external validity.
Repair-loop prompt sensitivity and oscillation risk not fully bounded in design.
Latency budget and operational plausibility need concrete numerical targets.
required_design_repairs: Specify an external oracle or multi-verifier strategy (e.g., Batfish + secondary checks) to estimate verifier false negatives.
Define precise dataset construction rules and vendor-coverage statistics; publish CLI grammar/transform artifacts used.
Preregister numeric latency/iteration budgets and operational thresholds (e.g., max median latency allowed).
Add prompt-robustness checks (prompt perturbation sensitivity analysis) and seed/version the prompts and LLM model identifier used.

major_concerns: False-negative estimates depend on the oracle/simulator completeness — risk of biased trade-off curves.
Synthetic high-throughput workload may not reflect real request correlations or worst-case topologies.
Caching/incremental strategies introduce statefulness that complicates reproducibility and comparison.
required_design_repairs: Define and validate the oracle/simulator used to detect false negatives, and report its coverage/limitations.
Specify workload generator, correlation structure, topology suites, and make them public for reproducibility.
Preregister exact verifier modes (check lists) and caching/incremental algorithms with deterministic replayability.
Include resource-budget constraints and measurement methodology (CPU/time, parallelism) to ensure feasibility claims are reproducible.

major_concerns: Constructing accurate vendor CLI grammars from public sources is error-prone and may block valid configs (false positives).
Tokenization/decoder integration details (model tokenizer compatibility) are underspecified.
Fairness of comparison vs RAG+verifier depends on retrieval freshness and verifier coverage.
required_design_repairs: Provide provenance for CLI grammars and publish grammar artifacts; define fallback for incomplete grammars.
Specify decoder integration details (tokenizer alignment, how constraints are enforced at token-level) and open-source or reproducible implementation.
Preregister evaluation parity controls (same prompts, same datasets, same verifier where applied) and include qualitative failure exemplars.
Measure and report blocked-valid-config rate (false blocks) in addition to prevented violations.

major_concerns: Simulated policy environment may not reflect real operational costs or human escalation behavior.
Model confidence calibration methods and their operational stability need stronger specification.
Ground-truth labeling noise and oracle error will materially affect Pareto-front estimates.
required_design_repairs: Specify the ground-truth labeling process and quantify label noise; include sensitivity analyses under label-noise scenarios.
Prespecify calibration procedures (e.g., temperature-scaling protocol, held-out calibration sets) and quantify calibration quality (Brier score, ECE).
Define the operational cost function used to trade off coverage vs false-accepts and justify weight choices or present multiple weighting regimes.
Include experiments showing robustness of selected thresholds under perturbations (model update, verifier blind spots).
